links.comparator_used: RAG-disabled mode of the same six LLMs (parametric knowledge only) within the Wysa DMHI
links.outcome: Intent detection performance (accuracy, recall, precision, F1) for multi-class intents such as self-harm, abuse and panic
links.effect: No numeric values given in the abstract; RAG-enabled mode is reported to improve accuracy, consistency and safety, with differences tested for statistical significance
links.tradeoff: RAG caused a rise in false alarms (lower precision); flagged cases are routed to additional review rather than acted on directly
links.quote: Overall, these findings support RAG as a promising approach to improve the accuracy, consistency and safety of LLM-driven DMHIs.
